correctness.rationale: For F=X^3Y+Y^3Z+Z^3X over char3, gradient (Z³,X³,Y³) is nowhere projectively zero. Taylor expansion has linear tangent and cubic term (br³+cs³+at³), no quadratic; cubic vanishes identically on tangent direction precisely when (b,c,a) proportional to (c^9,a^9,b^9). On affine X=1 this gives P_u=[1:u^10:u], u^91=1 and F(P_u)=u³(u^28+u^7+1)=0. Let v=u^7; v^4+v+1=(v-1)(v³+v²+v-1) divides v^13-1 mod3 (independently checked exact polynomial remainder 0). Three primitive-order13 roots plus v=1 have seven u preimages each, with u orders (1,7,13,91) in counts (1,6,3,18). Orders of 3 mod 7,13,91 are 6,3,6; Frobenius orbits 1,3,6,6,6,6. Coefficient u³ on tangent determines its field. No bitangents by contact >=3 twice contradicting Bezout degree4. Geometric 28 already known, not credited as novel.
